description: Get the credits an image create request charges. Pass `tool`, then the fields below that the tool's create request uses, with the same values. Does not create a project or spend credits. It prices the fields passed here. It does not check your plan, your balance or the rest of the create request.

image_count.description: The `image_count` of the create request. Used by `ai-image-generator`, `ai-image-editor`. Defaults to 1.

mode.description: The `style.mode` of the create request. Used by `ai-image-upscaler`. One of `preserve`, `balanced`, `creative`. Defaults to `balanced`.

model.description: The `model` of the create request. Used by `ai-image-generator`, `ai-image-editor`.

resolution.description: The `resolution` of the create request. Used by `ai-image-generator`, `ai-image-editor`, `body-swap`. One of `640px`, `1k`, `2k`, `4k`.

scale_factor.description: The `scale_factor` of the create request. Used by `ai-image-upscaler`. One of `2`, `4`.

tool.description: The create endpoint to price, named by its path. For example `ai-image-editor` for `POST /v1/ai-image-editor`.

name: estimate_image

estimated_credits.description: Credits a create request with these fields charges.

title: Estimate image credits
